name: Basement Infinity
bio: The sacred engine room of funk — the birthplace of the 7 Sparks and the Generator System. All frequencies pass through this realm before becoming audible.
visualStyle: Endless black void with neon gridlines and pulsing waveforms.

name: The Mothership
bio: A living vessel captained by StarChild, used to awaken sleeping minds and deliver funk to starved dimensions. It's both a ship and a temple.
visualStyle: Futuristic chrome architecture fused with Afrofuturistic neon glyphs and sound-reactive panels.

name: The Silent Floor
bio: A dead zone where Sir Nose drains all rhythm and flavor. The place where groove goes to die. Entry requires psychic armor.
visualStyle: Endless marble floors, dim red lights, and mirrored surfaces — emotionless, sterile, quiet.

name: The Crate Keep
bio: A metaphysical library of every sample, breakbeat, and soulful whisper ever recorded — guarded by sentient turntables.
visualStyle: Infinite dusty shelves, spinning vinyl in midair, glowing crate markers that hum when approached.

name: The Feedback Chamber
location: The Heart of the Soul Syncer
bio: A volatile energy chamber where raw emotion is turned into usable sound-matter — the creation crucible for producers and beat-smiths.
visualStyle: Pulsing plasma walls, suspended speakers emitting light, rings of floating notes forming atoms.

name: The Groove Wells
bio: Massive underground reservoirs of concentrated emotional funk. Artists drink from these to feel what can’t be spoken.
visualStyle: Lakes of swirling neon with speakers submerged under the surface, glowing fish that emit vibes instead of light.
